source.notes: arch-057 — composition-now as a typed parameter-domain composition. The mixer is attention over a fixed parameter-token source domain: scores = query @ key_paramᵀ × scale (a plain inner product, NO softmax denominator); a parameter-domain nonlinear normalizer (softmax=exp+L1×count / gelu_l2_norm / l2_norm_gelu); output = norm(scores) @ value_param. Verified against megatron/model/tokenformer.py @ 4d56c73f. The closed K1 softmax contract does not cover the non-softmax score stage, so the module composes typed matmul calls around the external normalizer (no descriptor hack). Layer module: architectures/pattention.py.

coverage.notes: Layer parity vs the pinned Pattention module across all three normalizer variants and a non-unit scale in tests/test_architectures_pattention.py; parameter-token gradients flow through the contraction. NOT claimed (sweep blockers): the model-replacement role (Pattention substituting for QKV/output projections and the MLP), parameter-token construction/reparameterization, and any claim that one attention contraction equals MLP or MoE.
